about: Formats what a person types to a pattern while they type. The pattern's own characters appear between the typed ones, a character the pattern refuses is dropped, and the caret keeps its place among the typed characters. `9` reads a digit, `a` a letter, `A` a letter written in capitals and `*` either. `number` formats a number in a locale instead.
applied: Voucher applied. The discount shows at checkout.

brand.about: The function passed as `mask` returns `9999 999999 99999` for an American Express number, which starts with 34 or 37, and four groups of four digits for every other card.
brand.title: A pattern per card brand

eager.about: `eager` writes the pattern's next characters once the digits before them are typed, so `12` shows as `12/`. `onValueComplete` checks the month when the fourth digit is typed, and the field shows its error for a month over 12.
eager.title: Eager

expiryHelp: Month and year, as printed on the card.

form.about: The field requires a complete Dutch IBAN. Submitting a shorter one shows the error text. `A` writes the country and bank codes in capitals whatever case the reader types.
form.title: Required in a form

grouped: Type the digits alone. The field groups them as the card prints them.
ibanShort: Enter all 18 characters of the IBAN.

lengths.about: `mask` takes an array of patterns. The input uses the shortest pattern that fits every typed digit, so five digits show as a ZIP code and a sixth adds the hyphen of ZIP+4.
lengths.title: A pattern per length

looks.about: The input group's three looks, on a phone number masked as `(999) 999-9999`.
looks.title: Looks

noAmount: Enter an amount to see what the payee receives.

number.about: `number` formats the value with the grouping and decimal separators of `nl-NL` while the reader types. `onValueChange` reports the number itself as `unmasked`, such as `1250.00`, and the helper text derives what the payee receives.
number.title: Number

receives: The payee receives {{received}} after the {{fee}} fee.

sizes.about: Every size of the input group. The pattern is the same at each size.
sizes.title: Sizes

states.about: An invalid input, a read-only input and a disabled one. The root takes each state, or the field around it passes it.
states.title: States

title: Input mask

tokens.about: `tokens` adds `X`, a letter or a digit written in capitals. `onValueChange` reports whether the code fills the pattern, and Apply is disabled until it does.
tokens.title: A token of your own

voucherHelp: Twelve letters or digits, printed on the back of the card.
zipHelp: Five digits, or nine with the ZIP+4 code.
